cards.front: Sabía que estarías aquí.
cards.back: I might have known that you'd be here.

cards.front: Sabía que estarías detrás de todo esto.
cards.back: I might have known that you'd be behind all this.

cards.front: Sabía que hablarías a todo el mundo de nuestro secreto.
cards.back: I might have known that you'd tell everyone about our secret.

cards.front: ¡Debí haber sabido que eso iba a ocurrir!
cards.back: I should have known that was going to happen!

cards.front: Debí haber sabido que no habría autobuses un domingo por la noche.
cards.back: I should have known that there wouldn't be any buses on a Sunday night.

cards.front: Debí haber sabido que nadie iba a querer ir.
cards.back: I should have known that nobody would want to go.

cards.front: Debí haber sabido la respuesta.
cards.back: I ought to have known the answer.

cards.front: Debí haber sabido dónde encontrarla.
cards.back: I ought to have known where to find her.

cards.front: Debí haber sabido que algo saldría mal.
cards.back: I ought to have known something would go wrong.

cards.front: Debiste haber sabido que no tenías que contar nada a Wendy sobre la fiesta sorpresa.
cards.back: You should have known not to tell Wendy about the surprise party.

cards.front: Debiste haber sabido que no debías confiar en él.
cards.back: You should have known not to trust him.

cards.front: Debiste haber sabido que no debías involucrarte.
cards.back: You should have known not to get involved.

cards.front: Debiste haber aprendido que no hay que ir allí solo por la noche.
cards.back: You should have known better than to go there alone at night.

cards.front: Debías haber sabido que no hay que dejar la puerta de entrada sin cerrar.
cards.back: You should have known better than to leave your front door unlocked.

cards.front: Debías haber aprendido a no provocarle.
cards.back: You should have known better than to provoke him.

cards.front: De haber sabido que eras tú, habría contestado el teléfono.
cards.back: Had I known it was you, I would've answered the phone.

cards.front: De haber sabido que ella iba a estar ahí, probablemente no me habría ido.
cards.back: Had I known she was going to be there, I probably wouldn't have gone.

cards.front: De haber sabido que iba a causar tantos problemas, no les habría dado las llaves.
cards.back: Had I known it was going to cause so many problems, I wouldn't have given them the keys.

cards.front: De haber sabido por qué ellos estaban aquí, no les habría dicho que se fueran.
cards.back: Had I known why they were here, I wouldn't have told them to leave.

cards.front: De haber sabido por qué él estaba disgustado, no habría sido tan duro con él.
cards.back: Had I known why he was upset, I wouldn't have been so hard on him.

cards.front: De haber sabido por qué la mercancía no había llegado, no me habría quejado.
cards.back: Had I known why the goods hadn't arrived, I wouldn't have complained.

cards.front: De haber sabido dónde estaba el restaurante, no habría llegado tan tarde.
cards.back: Had I known where the restaurant was, I wouldn't have been quite so late.

cards.front: De haber sabido dónde estaba el país, te podría haber advertido de que no fueras allí.
cards.back: Had I known where the country was, I could've warned you not to go there.

cards.front: De haber sabido a dónde ibas, te habría seguido.
cards.back: Had I known where you were going, I would've followed you.

cards.front: De haber sabido quién estaba detrás de todo, no me habría importado tanto.
cards.back: Had I known who was behind it all, I wouldn't have minded as much.

cards.front: De haber sabido quién era aquel hombre, no me habría esforzado tanto en ser agradable.
cards.back: Had I known who the man was, I wouldn't have made such an effort to be friendly.

cards.front: De haber sabido quién eras, no te habría colgado.
cards.back: Had I known who you were, I wouldn't have put the phone down on you.

cards.front: Si supiera conducir, habría ido yo mismo allí a recogerte.
cards.back: Had I known how to drive, I would've gone there myself to pick you up.

cards.front: De haber sabido hablar portugués, no habríamos tenido tantos problemas.
cards.back: Had I known how to speak Portuguese, we wouldn't have had so many problems.

cards.front: De haber sabido cuán seria era la situación, no me habría enfadado.
cards.back: Had I known how serious the situation was, I wouldn't have gotten angry.

cards.front: Ojalá supiera cuál es la respuesta.
cards.back: I wish I knew what the answer was.

cards.front: Ojalá supiera a qué hora empieza la película.
cards.back: I wish I knew what time the movie starts.

cards.front: Ojalá supiera dónde guardan ellos sus pilas de repuesto.
cards.back: I wish I knew where they kept their spare batteries.

cards.front: Ojalá supiera cómo llegar allí.
cards.back: I wish I knew how to get there.

cards.front: Ojalá supiera cómo funciona la máquina.
cards.back: I wish I knew how this machine worked.

cards.front: Ojalá supiera cómo encajan estas piezas.
cards.back: I wish I knew how these parts fit together.

cards.front: ¿Te gustaría saber pilotar un helicóptero?
cards.back: Do you wish you knew how to fly a helicopter?

cards.front: ¿Te gustaría saber más sobre tu tatarabuelo?
cards.back: Do you wish you knew more about your great-great-grandfather?

cards.front: ¿Te gustaría saber hablar chino con soltura?
cards.back: Do you wish you knew how to speak Chinese fluently?

cards.front: Ojalá lo hubiera sabido antes de que fuese demasiado tarde.
cards.back: I wish I'd known before it was too late.

cards.front: Ojalá hubiese sabido la verdad antes de decir todas esas cosas.
cards.back: I wish I'd known the truth before I went and said all those things.

cards.front: Ojalá lo hubiera sabido antes de casarme.
cards.back: I wish I'd known about it before I got married.

cards.front: ¿Te habría gustado haberlo sabido cuando eras joven?
cards.back: Do you wish you'd known when you were young?

cards.front: ¿Te habría gustado haberlo sabido cuando los viste el año pasado?
cards.back: Do you wish you'd known when you saw them last year?

cards.front: ¿Te habría gustado haber sabido cuándo parar?
cards.back: Do you wish you'd known when to stop?

cards.front: Conociéndole a ella, estará todavía en la cama.
cards.back: Knowing her, she's probably still in bed.

cards.front: Conociéndoles a ellos, no se habrán levantado todavía.
cards.back: Knowing them, they're probably not up yet.

cards.front: Conociéndole a él, se le habrán pegado las sábanas.
cards.back: Knowing him, he's probably overslept.

cards.front: Conociéndole a él, seguro que llega tarde.
cards.back: Knowing him, he's bound to be late.

cards.front: Conociéndole a ella, seguro que cancela la reunión.
cards.back: Knowing her, she's bound to cancel the meeting.

cards.front: Conociendo a las chicas, seguro que no están haciendo nada bueno.
cards.back: Knowing the girls, they're bound to be up to no good.

cards.front: Conociendo a esos dos, seguro que se han perdido por ahí.
cards.back: Knowing those two, they're bound to have got lost somewhere.

cards.front: Conociendo a mi padre, seguro que se ha equivocado de dirección.
cards.back: Knowing my father, he's bound to have got the wrong address.

cards.front: Conociendo a Patrick, seguro que se ha equivocado de iglesia.
cards.back: Knowing Patrick, he's bound to have gone to the wrong church.

cards.front: Conociendo a esos dos, estoy segura de que no estarán haciendo nada bueno, como que me llamo María.
cards.back: Knowing those two, they're up to no good. I'll be bound!

cards.front: Conociendo a ésos, estoy seguro de que llegarán tarde, como que me llamo Paco.
cards.back: Knowing that lot, they'll be late. I'll be bound!

cards.front: ¡No me lo puedo creer!
cards.back: Well, I'll be bound!

cards.front: De haber sabido entonces lo que sé ahora, nunca me habría ido de mi antigua empresa.
cards.back: Knowing then what I know now, I would never have left my old company.

cards.front: Si hubiera sabido entonces lo que ahora sé, nunca habría dicho aquello.
cards.back: Knowing then what I know now, I would never have said that.

cards.front: De haber sabido entonces lo que sé ahora, habría hecho las cosas de otra manera.
cards.back: Knowing then what I know now, I would have done things differently.

cards.front: Dave sabe cómo funciona esto; no nos fallará.
cards.back: Dave knows what's what; he won't let us down.

cards.front: Susie lleva más de veinte años en el negocio; sabe de lo que habla.
cards.back: Susie has been in the business for more than twenty years; she knows what's what.

cards.front: No te preocupes por los niños; ellos saben de lo que hablan.
cards.back: Oh, don't worry about the kids; they know what's what.

cards.front: Él no se puede quejar ahora; ya conocía la jugada cuando firmó el contrato.
cards.back: He can't complain now; he knew the score when he signed the contract.

cards.front: Ya conoces los términos del trato; recibirás el dinero cuando termines el trabajo.
cards.back: You know the score; you'll get the money when you finish the job.

cards.front: No tenemos que decirles nada; conocen la jugada.
cards.back: We don't have to tell them anything; they know the score.

cards.front: Yo no discutiría con él sobre literatura francesa; se conoce el tema de cabo a rabo.
cards.back: I wouldn't argue with him about French literature; he knows the subject inside out.

cards.front: Pregúntale a Tim; conoce este programa de ordenador al detalle.
cards.back: Ask Tim; he knows this computer program inside out.

cards.front: Llevo toda la vida en esta ciudad; es normal que la conozca como la palma de la mano.
cards.back: Well, I have lived in this town all my life; it's normal that I know it inside out.

cards.front: Él no puede decir eso sobre Julie: no entiende nada de mujeres.
cards.back: He can't say that about Julie; he doesn't know the first thing about women.

cards.front: No sé por qué se lo preguntaste a ella; no tiene ni idea sobre jazz.
cards.back: I don't know why you asked her; she doesn't know the first thing about jazz music.

cards.front: Quienquiera que haya escrito esta basura no tiene la más mínima idea sobre Almodóvar.
cards.back: Whoever wrote this rubbish doesn't know the first thing about Almodóvar.

cards.front: Nos dan tantas indicaciones contradictorias que estamos hechos un lío.
cards.back: They give us so many contradictory instructions that we don't know if we're coming or going.

cards.front: Hemos estado tan ocupados últimamente que estamos hechos un lío.
cards.back: We've been so busy lately that we don't know if we're coming or going.

cards.front: ¿Qué te pasa? Parece como si estuvieras hecho un lío.
cards.back: What's wrong with you? You look like you don't know if you're coming or going.

cards.front: Que yo sepa, no estaban juntos esa noche.
cards.back: To the best of my knowledge, they weren't together that night.

cards.front: Es la primera vez que he visto ese documento, que yo sepa.
cards.back: To the best of my knowledge, it's the first time I've seen this document.

cards.front: Que yo sepa, la información que proporcioné era verdadera.
cards.back: To the best of my knowledge, the information I provided was true.

cards.front: No, que yo sepa.
cards.back: Not to my knowledge.

cards.front: Cuando le preguntaron si alguna vez había estado con la mujer en cuestión, contestó «no, que yo sepa».
cards.back: When asked if he had ever been with the woman in question, he answered "not to my knowledge".

cards.front: Cuando dices «no, que yo sepa», ¿en realidad quieres decir que sabes perfectamente lo que pasó?
cards.back: When you say "not to my knowledge", do you actually mean that you know perfectly well what happened?

cards.front: Todo el mundo sabe que él es polaco.
cards.back: It's common knowledge he's Polish.

cards.front: Todo el mundo sabe que va a haber recortes severos.
cards.back: It's common knowledge that there are going to be severe cutbacks.

cards.front: Todo el mundo sabe que no cantaron ninguna de sus canciones de éxito.
cards.back: It's common knowledge that they didn't sing on any of their hit songs.

cards.front: Nos hemos enterado de que has estado inventando tus cifras de ventas.
cards.back: It has come to our knowledge that you've been making up your sales figures.

cards.front: Ella se enteró de que ni siquiera miraron su solicitud.
cards.back: It came to her knowledge that they never even looked at her application.

cards.front: ¡Me he enterado de que voy a ser muy rico cuando mi tío fallezca!
cards.back: It has come to my knowledge that I'm going to be very rich when my uncle passes away!

cards.front: No estábamos al tanto de lo que estaban tramando.
cards.back: We had no knowledge of what they were up to.

cards.front: ¿De verdad me estás contando que no sabías que tu mujer era una espía?
cards.back: Are you seriously telling me that you had no knowledge of the fact that your wife was a spy?

cards.front: No sé de lo que me estás hablando.
cards.back: I have no knowledge of what you're talking about.
